## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
RISK-ON. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive — broad strength. VXX (1W: -0.83% | 1M: -15.54%) BELOW TREND and SPY (1W: +1.11% | 1M: +1.16%) ABOVE TREND confirm risk appetite, with sector breadth (8/11) as a second independent confirmation.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Credit spread widening: Credit Spread (Level 0.7342) (1W: +0.26% | 1M: +0.90%) ABOVE TREND signals some stress while HYG (1W: +0.38% | 1M: +0.96%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.05% | 1M: +0.04%) ABOVE TREND show only mild spread relief. Gold and metals bid: GLD (1W: +3.83% | 1M: +6.76%) ABOVE TREND and SLV (1W: +8.21% | 1M: +32.25%) ABOVE TREND suggest risk hedging alongside risk-taking.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-supportive financial backdrop: UUP proxy (Dollar) (1W: +0.59% | 1M: +0.15%) ABOVE TREND while TLT (1W: +0.22% | 1M: -0.22%) RECOVERY keeps yields contained and SPY/TLT shown ABOVE TREND supports equity preference.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Cyclicals leading: XLE (1W: +4.12% | 1M: +3.36%) ABOVE TREND, XLB (1W: +4.74% | 1M: +9.81%) ABOVE TREND and XME (1W: +10.06% | 1M: +16.26%) ABOVE TREND. Tech lagging/rotating: XLK (1W: +0.19% | 1M: -2.15%) RECOVERY — style: Value/Cyclicals over Growth.

5. US vs Global?
EM outperformance emerging: EEM (1W: +3.95% | 1M: +5.61%) ABOVE TREND and FXI (1W: +2.90% | 1M: +0.91%) ABOVE TREND outpace SPY (1W: +1.11% | 1M: +1.16%) ABOVE TREND on a 1W basis.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculation healthy but selective: IWM (1W: +4.92% | 1M: +3.29%) ABOVE TREND and ARKK (1W: +4.72% | 1M: -1.72%) RECOVERY show risk flows, while IBIT (1W: +3.77% | 1M: +0.00%) NEUTRAL signals mixed crypto traction.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Precious metals leadership: PPLT (1W: +9.97% | 1M: +36.73%) ABOVE TREND, SLV (1W: +8.21% | 1M: +32.25%) ABOVE TREND and GLD (1W: +3.83% | 1M: +6.76%) ABOVE TREND; industrial metals supportive with CPER (1W: +2.06% | 1M: +7.34%) ABOVE TREND.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy strength intact: XLE (1W: +4.12% | 1M: +3.36%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +3.35% | 1M: +1.49%) ABOVE TREND, while natural gas remains weak: UNG (1W: -8.08% | 1M: -25.22%) BELOW TREND.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: Broad sector participation (8/11) and SPY (1W: +1.11% | 1M: +1.16%) ABOVE TREND support the RISK-ON label. DIVERGENCE: XLK (1W: +0.19% | 1M: -2.15%) RECOVERY, QQQ (1W: +1.00% | 1M: -0.48%) RECOVERY and TLT (1W: +0.22% | 1M: -0.22%) RECOVERY represent a MAJOR DIVERGENCE — monitor tech momentum and bond repricing.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor cyclicals/value exposure: XLF (1W: +2.05% | 1M: +5.55%) ABOVE TREND, XLB (1W: +4.74% | 1M: +9.81%) ABOVE TREND and XLE (1W: +4.12% | 1M: +3.36%) ABOVE TREND showing strength; reduce exposure to tech rotation risk with XLK (1W: +0.19% | 1M: -2.15%) RECOVERY and watch TLT (1W: +0.22% | 1M: -0.22%) RECOVERY for hedge sizing.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: XME (1W: +10.06% | 1M: +16.26%) ABOVE TREND, XLB (1W: +4.74% | 1M: +9.81%) ABOVE TREND, XLE (1W: +4.12% | 1M: +3.36%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: XLC (1W: -0.20% | 1M: +1.38%) CORRECTION and XLK (1W: +0.19% | 1M: -2.15%) RECOVERY — monitor for further rotation away from communication/tech.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: SLV (1W: +8.21% | 1M: +32.25%) ABOVE TREND, PPLT (1W: +9.97% | 1M: +36.73%) ABOVE TREND and CPER (1W: +2.06% | 1M: +7.34%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: UNG (1W: -8.08% | 1M: -25.22%) BELOW TREND remains vulnerable.

13. Key Levels?
VXX 20 watch — VXX (1W: -0.83% | 1M: -15.54%) BELOW TREND indicates lower fear but keep alert to spikes. HYG/LQD credit pivot near 0.74 with HYG (1W: +0.38% | 1M: +0.96%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.05% | 1M: +0.04%) ABOVE TREND; XLK/XLF ratio near 2.58 is the growth vs value pivot while SPY (1W: +1.11% | 1M: +1.16%) ABOVE TREND confirms equity leadership.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. XLE (1W: +4.12% | 1M: +3.36%) ABOVE TREND and XLB (1W: +4.74% | 1M: +9.81%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: MAJOR DIVERGENCE in tech and bonds — monitor XLK (1W: +0.19% | 1M: -2.15%) RECOVERY and TLT (1W: +0.22% | 1M: -0.22%) RECOVERY for momentum breakdowns.
